correctness.rationale: Cells of Hom(C5,K5) are tuples of nonempty color sets with adjacent sets disjoint. A target five-cycle cannot fix a cell: invariant nonempty color sets would all be the full five-color set. Schultz’s reduced model arises by forgetting certain source positions and a canonical face-poset isomorphism to the boundary of a derived regular neighborhood of the diagonal inside M×M, M=∂Δ4. All involved set inclusion, complement and derived-star constructions commute with target color permutations. Both source and reduced models are free G-CW complexes, so nonequivariant equivalence upgrades to G-homotopy equivalence. Taking quotient gives the sphere bundle of tangent space of M/G. The color permutation sum-zero representation splits into rotation planes of weights 1 and 2, so M/G = L(5;1,2). This oriented 3-manifold is parallelizable; tangent S²-bundle trivializes. Independent direct row-cell enumeration gave (1020,5700,13000,15000,8750,2070) cells, each in free orbit of size five; quotient cell counts (204,1140,2600,3000,1750,414) and Euler zero. Finite Euler counts corroborate, not prove, the PL normal-bundle argument.
